minutes_text:
MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  DECEMBER 17, 2024

  1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  A regular meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills
  Estates was called to order at 7:00 p.m. at City of Rolling Hills Estates Council
  Chambers, 4045 Palos Verdes Dr. N., Rolling Hills Estates, California, by CHAIR
  MCCORMICK.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  CHAIR MCCORMICK led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Pope, Ciarolla, Johnson, Holdsworth (joined at
  7:01 p.m.), Bain, Persichina and McCormick

  Commissioners Absent:  None

  City Staff Present:  Maintenance Superintendent Mike Goldsmith
  Community Services Supervisor Rosa Pinuelas
  Community Services Coordinator Matt Morrow

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT MINUTES OF
  NOVEMBER 19, 2024

  COMMISSIONER BAIN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER POPE
  to:

  APPROVE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF
  NOVEMBER 19, 2024.

  There being no objection, CHAIR MCCORMICK so ordered.

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

  NONE.

  COMMISSIONER HOLDSWORTH JOINED THE MEETING AT 7:01 PM

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  1
DECEMBER 17, 2024
   6.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  COMMITTEE, SUBCOMMITTEE, AND ADOPT-A-PARK ASSIGNMENTS

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief overview of the current Committee,
  Subcommittee, and Adopt-A-Park assignments (as per the agenda material).

  The Commission determined that the newly established Founders Park would be
  combined with the Dapplegray Park and Chandler Preserve assignments adding
  the park to Commissioner Johnson’s current Adopt-A-Park assignments.

  The Commission discussed the other assignments and came to a consensus
  regarding the overall Committee, Subcommittee, Adopt-A-Park assignments for
  the 2025 calendar year.

  B.  2025 COUNCIL MEETING ATTENDANCE SCHEDULE

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief overview of the 2025 Council Meeting Attendance
  Schedule (as per the agenda material).

  The Commission discussed the proposed schedule assignments and made
  changes as needed.

  7.  STAFF ITEMS

  A.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.
  8.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.

  B.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.

  9.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF NOVEMBER 12, 2024

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  2
DECEMBER 17, 2024
   10.  FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  A.  ASSESSMENT OF SPACE FOR POTENTIAL DOG PARK AND FUTURE PARKS

  NONE.

  11.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR MCCORMICK ADJOURNED THE MEETING AT 7:07 PM TO THE NEXT
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING ON JANUARY 21, 2025, AT
  7:00 P.M., WHICH WILL BE HELD AT CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CITY
  HALL.

  There being no objection, so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  __________________________  __________________________
  Matt Morrow  Ryan McCormick
  Community Services Coordinator  Chair, Park & Activities Commission

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  3
DECEMBER 17, 2024
